_meta.description: Consolidated unit normalization map. Previously existed as THREE separate, divergent sources: unit_extractor.py's vocabulary (Stage 2), normalization/unit_normalizer.py's UNIT_MAP, and Normalization_Training.md's own copy of UNIT_MAP - each with a different set of units/variants. This file is the single source of truth going forward for Stage 3's unit normalization. Stage 2's unit_extractor.py has its own separate, smaller vocabulary by design (it does fused-token regex extraction with OCR-corruption handling, a different job) - NOT unified with this file. This file is consumed only by ml_service/normalization/unit_normalizer.py.
_meta.note: Superset of the two normalization-side UNIT_MAPs found (the inline one in unit_normalizer.py and the separate one embedded in Normalization_Training.md, which had already drifted from each other - the doc's copy was missing MG/MCG/ST/CL/DL/TBSP/TSP/CUP and the container/misc entries the code copy had). Reconciled here as the superset; nothing was dropped.
